doc.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Personnel of the 1932 band in the Boston revue
summary: Berger reads out the first confirmed personnel from the Cocktails of 1932 review in Boston.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, you asked about the personnel. Let me give you what we have from . . .

This is August, September. I think that’s . . . the first confirmed personnel of that band would be, on trumpets, Leonard Davis; Lewis Bacon [phonetic], Dicky Wells on trombone, Chu Berry, Hilton Jefferson, and Wayman Carver on reeds.
Now, is this the one that was at the Empire Ballroom with me?
Well, this is the personnel that was in Boston [Massachusetts] with you, which was
. . . for a review, the Cocktails of 1932 review.
Did we go over this with Morroe?
Well, it was a review in the New York Age, so it was in print that this band appeared under your leadership.
So that may have been one of the earliest paying engagements of this orchestra, but . . .
